text: I keep losing half-formed ideas when I leave my desk.
The hippocampus may behave more like an index than a warehouse of complete memories.
Maps become unreadable when every note connects to every other note.
An assistant should show whether a connection came from me or from the model.
Maybe uncertainty belongs on relationships rather than only on thoughts.
Dreaming seems to combine distant experiences without requiring literal similarity.
When I return from a walk I often have a solution but cannot remember the steps that produced it.
The graph should sometimes traverse a weak edge to escape an obvious conceptual cluster.
If the model rewrites old memories it may gradually replace my perspective with its own.
A question that resolves several ambiguous links may be worth interrupting me for.
